name: yelnurqaratay
description: Guardrail hooks for Claude Code: no AI attribution, git confirmations, token hygiene, verify before done.

plugins.name: no-ai-attribution
plugins.description: Blocks Co-Authored-By: Claude and "Generated with Claude Code" in commits, tags, PRs/MRs and comments.

plugins.name: git-guard
plugins.description: Asks before git push, force-push, amend, rebase, reset --hard and other history-rewriting commands.

plugins.name: token-hygiene
plugins.description: Keeps API tokens out of prompts, commands and output; stores them in the macOS Keychain.

plugins.name: verify-before-done
plugins.description: Sends Claude back once when code changed but nothing was built or tested afterwards.
